notes.title: Fragile Packages: Handle with Care released now!
notes.content: [p]Fragile Packages: Handle with Care is officially available now.[/p][p][/p][p]Leap to it and give it a go to get to the mysterious platform in the sky. I'm so keen to see what people end up creating with the packages, from pathways to cardboard forts and all sorts in between.[/p][p][/p][p]All feedback welcomed and join the discord for discussions:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/wmuGkVW"]https://discord.gg/wmuGkVW[/url][/p]
